entities.summary: Jerzy Bronisław Braun, ps. "Bronisław Rogowski" was a Polish writer, political activist, poet, playwright, literary critic, columnist, screenwriter, philosopher, scout, the last chairman of the Council of National Unity, and the last Government Delegate for Poland from June 1945.
